d: Long, flowing grass-green hair is styled with side-swept bangs and a thick braid draped over the shoulder. The eyes are a vivid cerulean blue with a soft, pensive expression, set on a youthful face with a petite, slender build. The outfit consists of a white long-sleeved collared shirt, a teal necktie, and a sleeveless maroon jumper dress, paired with white thigh-high stockings held by black garters. Visible accessories include large, grey mechanical naval artillery rigging mounted on the back and sides.
